create_vtrace_from_logits: create V-trace off-policy actor critic targets from behaviour and target policy logits with importance weighting
compute_log_probs_from_logits: compute action log-probabilities from unnormalized policy logits and discrete action indices using sparse softmax cross-entropy
calculate_vtrace_from_importance_weights: calculate V-trace baseline targets and policy gradient advantages from log importance weights and trajectory data
build_vtrace_baseline_targets: build V-trace value function estimates as training targets for a baseline network with clipped importance weights
compute_pg_advantages: compute policy gradient advantages using V-trace corrected returns with separate clipping thresholds for baseline and policy gradient
